# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

O a Waadic apagapi, pecuite Diosta waenoponuwate, yadpaunwate waenoponwate wahenda wayoro queri sadis iue on dieñanda inpuene catembet iene nunda apag ewe ue ununin wambachiwapuere, dacue eete joaeri.
